headline: Waist-high ESE at a prime angle — surf the glassy morning before it goes onshore.
today: The swell's on the right angle (ESE, prime) but it's short-period at 5s, so figure chest-high peelers at best. Dawn and morning are light and glassy — that's your window, log or fish, and work the incoming tide off the 11:53a low. Once the SSE onshore fills in around midday it turns to mush, so get it early.

daysToWatch.note: Small and onshore, building to 18mph S by evening. Junky — skip it.
3-4ft with N offshore all day. Only fair angle and short-period, but offshore wind and size make it the pick of the week. Shortboard or fish.
Chest-high at 6.5-7s with light morning wind. Clean dawn window before the afternoon SSE onshore — worth a session.
